note: Native application menu bar -- renders fixed OS-level menu labels (File, Edit, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help)
Activity bar and secondary action bar -- renders fixed view icons and labels (Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings)
Viewlet header -- renders fixed view title and action buttons (Refresh, Clear, New Editor, List, Collapse)
Search input controls -- renders fixed toggle labels (Case Sensitive, Whole Word, Regex) and button icons; the query text is a value handled by the deterministic pass
Search details toggle -- renders fixed 'More' label and icon
Search status message -- renders fixed platform copy (e.g., 'No results found') and action links
Editor tab bar -- renders fixed action buttons (Close, Split, More); tab labels are file names (user content) but the container is primarily chrome controls
Getting Started page -- renders fixed platform documentation, category titles, descriptions, and action buttons
Status bar -- renders fixed status indicators and labels (Host, SCM, Problems, Ports, Notifications, Screen Reader Mode)
